requirements.source_anchor: G6 Summary & Handover Appendix Section 7 (Field Ownership)
requirements.requirement: Establish clear field ownership mapping between local Room entities, remote Firestore documents, and imported historical structures.

requirements.source_anchor: G6 Summary & Handover Appendix Section 7 (Credential & Session Isolation)
requirements.requirement: Enforce strict credential and session isolation across reseller accounts to prevent cross-account state leakage.

requirements.source_anchor: Handover Appendix Section 4 (Legacy / Protected Semantic Fields)
requirements.requirement: Preserve legacy semantic fields (loanIqd, isLegacy, isSnapshotHistory, stateSource, stateConfidence) without deletion, repurposing, or conversion into alternate financial authority.

requirements.source_anchor: Handover Appendix Section 3 (Financial History & ISP Deletion Protection)
requirements.requirement: ISP-side deletion MUST NOT physically delete local financial history; RemoteSyncCoordinator applyAccountDelete / applyLedgerDelete must protect local records and prohibit ON DELETE CASCADE on financial ledger.

requirements.source_anchor: G7 Summary & Handover Appendix Section 7 (Non-Destructive Migration)
requirements.requirement: Execute non-destructive schema migrations preserving all business data with migration interruption safety (INV-14).

requirements.source_anchor: G7 Summary & Handover Appendix Section 7 (Backup Compatibility)
requirements.requirement: Maintain backwards-compatible backup export/import schema deserialization across application versions.
